annotation.interpretation_a: Implementations can choose to sort the key-value pairs alphabetically, or by some other criteria, before presenting them.
annotation.interpretation_b: Implementations can present the key-value pairs in a completely random order.
annotation.justification: The use of "MAY" grants implementations broad discretion in the ordering of elements. While not strictly an *inconsistency*, the lack of any constraint on ordering could lead to interoperability issues if different implementations choose drastically different ordering schemes. A missing constraint specifying a canonical order would resolve this.
